so_what: 12-team depth means the injury-driven waiver moves below clear thinner and faster here than in the HBGBs, with no bidding history yet to anchor a price.

TreVeyon Henderson, one of your two FLEX starters, is trending toward inactive for Wednesday's opener after two full weeks without a practice rep, and his direct beneficiary Rhamondre Stevenson belongs to a different owner (kate0826) here.
Jeremiyah Love, one of your starting RBs, still hasn't practiced since mid-August — combined with Henderson, two of your four RB/FLEX spots are genuinely in doubt for the opener.
Rachaad White on your bench is a two-man Commanders committee piece behind Jacory Croskey-Merritt, not a bell cow, so treat him as thin bye-week cover only.
JSN and Saquon Barkley (sbbroom's) are both locked, coordinator-named focal points in fresh schemes heading into Week 1 — no lineup decision required.
Nico Collins, one of your starting WRs, gets a quiet target-share tailwind from Jayden Higgins' season-ending ACL tear in Houston's receiver room.
Week 1 openers run Wednesday Sept. 9 through Monday Sept. 14; this is the league's baseline brief with no prior brief to diff against.
